c74object.name: el.shoehorn~
c74object.digest: Proportional multi-channel upmixing and downmixing spatializer
c74object.description:
el.shoehorn~ upmixes or downmixes an N-channel audio input across an M-channel audio output along a linear soundstage (from 2 up to 1024 channels). The outermost channels are anchored directly: Input 1 routes to Output 1 (extreme left), and Input N routes to Output M (extreme right). All intermediate input channels are geometrically distributed and equal-power panned across the corresponding output pairs. This provides seamless downmixing (such as 8 channels to stereo) or upmixing (such as stereo or quad to an 8- or 16-channel array) while preserving proportional spatial imaging.
Inlets
Inlets 1 to N (signal): Audio input channels 1 through N (total count determined by the first argument, default: 2).
Outlets
Outlets 1 to M (signal): Audio output channels 1 through M (total count determined by the second argument, default: 2).

inlet.description: Incoming audio signals to be spatially mapped and panned across the output channels.

outlet.description: Proportionally mapped and panned audio output channels.

objarg.name: input-channel-count
objarg.description: Required. The number of audio input channels to allocate (default: 2, range: 2 to 1024).

objarg.name: output-channel-count
objarg.description: Required. The number of audio output channels to allocate (default: 2, range: 2 to 1024).

method.name: signal
method.description: Signals arriving at inlets 1 through N are proportionally mapped and equal-power panned to outlets 1 through M.
